questions.stem: What is the function of the sieve plates found between sieve tube elements?

options.text: They absorb water from the surrounding xylem vessels
They provide structural strength like lignin in xylem
They allow dissolved sugars to pass through pores from one cell to the next
They block the movement of sugars to prevent over-feeding

questions.explanation: Sieve plates are the end walls between sieve tube elements that contain pores. These pores allow the dissolved sugars and other organic solutes to flow continuously from one sieve tube element to the next along the phloem.
